intel.title: [CISA KEV] Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions - Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions Double Free Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-33824
廠商: Microsoft
產品: Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions
漏洞名稱: Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions Double Free Vulnerability
說明: Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions contains a double free vulnerability that could enable remote code execution.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-08-21
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: 微軟 Internet Key Exchange (IKE) 服務擴充套件存在雙重釋放漏洞（CVE-2026-33824），已被證實遭用於活躍攻擊中。攻擊者可藉此漏洞進行遠端程式碼執行（RCE），嚴重威脅地端 Windows 伺服器安全。
analysis.recommendation: 1. 針對公司內運行的『資訊軟體-伺服器軟體-Windows Server 2019』及相關 Windows VM 主機（如 AD 主機、ERP 主機等），立即套用微軟官方發布之安全更新。2. 在未完成修補前，建議透過防火牆限制外部網路對 Windows 主機之 UDP 500 與 UDP 4500 端口（IKE/IPsec 相關服務）的直接存取。
affected_assets: 資訊軟體-伺服器軟體-Windows Server 2019

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Broadcom VMware vCenter - Broadcom VMware vCenter Path Traversal Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-59310
廠商: Broadcom
產品: VMware vCenter
漏洞名稱: Broadcom VMware vCenter Path Traversal Vulnerability
說明: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a threat actor with network access to vCenter to execute arbitrary code.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-08-21
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Broadcom VMware vCenter 存在路徑遍歷漏洞（CVE-2026-59310），允許具備網路存取權限的攻擊者執行任意程式碼（RCE）。此漏洞已被收錄於 CISA KEV，顯示已有活躍的攻擊利用。由於公司內部使用 Vmware vSphere HA 架構，可能間接受到此漏洞威脅，需儘速盤點並修補。
analysis.recommendation:
1. 立即排查內部 Vmware vSphere 環境中是否部署並啟用了 vCenter Server。
2. 依據 Broadcom 官方安全公告，儘速將 vCenter Server 升級至已修補之安全版本。
3. 嚴格限制 vCenter 管理介面的網路存取權限，僅允許特定信任的內部管理網段連線，避免暴露於未授權的網路環境中。
affected_assets: 資訊軟體-虛擬平台軟體-DELL OEM Vmware DELL vSphere Essentials Plus Kit
資訊軟體-虛擬平台軟體-VMWare Esxi6.5

analysis.summary: Microsoft SharePoint 存在弱身分驗證漏洞（CVE-2026-55040），允許未授權的攻擊者繞過網路安全功能。此漏洞已被 CISA 列入已知被利用漏洞（KEV）清單，代表已有活躍的攻擊活動。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Apple macOS - Apple macOS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-65400
廠商: Apple
產品: macOS
漏洞名稱: Apple macOS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
說明: Apple macOS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker on the network to authenticate to Screen Sharing without valid credentials.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-08-21
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown
reference_urls: https://support.apple.com/en-us/148170; https://support.apple.com/en-us/148171; https://support.apple.com/en-us/148172 ; BOD 26-04: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; Forensics Triage Requirements: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-implementation-guidance-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-65400

analysis.summary: Apple macOS 存在身分驗證不當漏洞（CVE-2026-65400），攻擊者可透過網路在無有效憑證的情況下，直接驗證並登入螢幕共享（Screen Sharing）功能。此漏洞已被列入 CISA KEV 活躍攻擊名冊，對企業內部使用 macOS 的工作電腦構成極高安全風險。
analysis.recommendation:
1. 立即盤點公司內部所有 macOS 工作電腦，並更新至 Apple 官方發布之最新安全修補版本。
2. 在完成修補前，建議於系統設定中關閉「螢幕共享」（Screen Sharing）與「遠端管理」（Remote Management）功能。
3. 透過防火牆或 VPN 限制遠端桌面相關通訊埠的網路存取，避免其暴露於公開網路中。
affected_assets: 資訊設備-桌上型電腦/筆記型電腦
